newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Madagascar inflation falls, growth rate increases.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar inflation falls, growth rate increases.

text.p: Inflation in Madagascar this year has fallen below seven percent and economic growth has doubled to between 3.5 and four percent, Prime Minister Pascal Rakotomavo said on Sunday in a progress report prepared for the National Assembly.
World Bank figures show the inflation rate as 39 percent in 1994, 37 percent in 1995 and eight percent in 1996.
Economic growth, only 0.2 per cent in 1994, was estimated at just below two percent in 1996.
